author: DeDust
description: DeDust Pool V1 is a legacy liquidity pool where users swap an asset pair and liquidity providers earn fees from early DeDust markets.

declarations.name: Errors

members.name: InvalidLpOrFeeSender
members.description: LP burn notification or protocol-fee sender is not authorized.

members.name: InvalidControlSender
members.description: Control message sender is not the stored Factory/proof address.

members.name: InvalidAssetOrProof
members.description: Asset tag or proof shape is invalid for this Pool.

members.name: InvalidVaultSender
members.description: Swap-external sender is not the authenticated Vault.

members.name: InvalidPoolSender
members.description: Swap-peer sender is not the authenticated Pool.

members.name: InvalidLiquidityDepositSender
members.description: Liquidity-deposit callback sender is not the authenticated deposit contract.

members.name: UnsupportedOperation
members.description: Incoming internal message opcode is unsupported.

declarations.description: DeDust Pool v1 exit codes.

get_methods.name: get_version
get_methods.description: Return the DeDust Pool code/interface version.

get_methods.name: is_stable
get_methods.description: Return whether this Pool instance is stable-swap.

get_methods.name: get_trade_fee
get_methods.description: Return the current trade-fee numerator and denominator.

get_methods.name: get_protocol_fees
get_methods.description: Return accumulated protocol fees for both assets.

get_methods.name: get_assets
get_methods.description: Return serialized asset identifiers for this Pool.

get_methods.name: estimate_swap_out
get_methods.description: Estimate output amount and fee for a serialized input asset and amount.

get_methods.name: estimate_deposit_out
get_methods.description: Estimate accepted deposit amounts and fair LP supply for proposed asset amounts.

get_methods.name: get_jetton_data
get_methods.description: Return LP Jetton minter data for the Pool.

get_methods.name: get_wallet_address
get_methods.description: Return the deterministic LP wallet address for an owner.
